items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eleven vulnerabilities, with CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap) being a critical template engine injection allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution (CVSS 10.0). It also includes CVE-2026-92909, an incorrect authorization flaw leading to unauthenticated code execution (CVSS 9.8).

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: An unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) allows unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious files disguised as images via the guest cart API, leading to arbitrary code execution. This flaw has been actively exploited in the wild and was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. Adobe confirmed active exploitation in the wild, with attacks starting as early as September 4, 2026.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Stored XSS and Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201 with CVSS 9.3) and incorrect authorization issues. Adobe reported no known exploits in the wild at the time of publication.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Incorrect Authorization and Stored XSS
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including a critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that could lead to privilege escalation. It also addresses several stored cross-site scripting issues.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks and Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This bulletin fixes five vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated arbitrary code execution flaw in the webhooks component (CVE-2026-48358, CVSS 10.0) and a critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) that could lead to privilege escalation.
